name: kubedesk-plugin-kubectl-helper
description: Copy the kubectl command of any object, and see the requests and limits of pods
author: Kube Desk

features: Copy the kubectl command that gets any object, from its menu
Copy kubectl config use-context for the cluster, from ⌘K
A Resources tab for pods: each container's requests and limits
Choose the command (kubectl, k, oc) and the output format

scripts.build: bun build src/index.tsx --outfile dist/main.js --format cjs --target browser --external react --external 'react/*' --external react-dom --external kubedesk --production
